reentry_reason: Rapid parallel main movement exposed a newer Trigger-1 v5 specificity gate after the predecessor source inspection. Preserve the predecessor artifact as historical evidence and issue this successor rather than silently rewriting it.

v5_test.observation: The positive extra-specificity fixture passes by setting summary booleans and 64-hex receipt-shaped strings. No semantic factorial case table or interaction-analysis receipt content is reconstructed by the v5 helper.

reentry_verdict.statement: v5 materially strengthens scientific specificity but does not close the evidence-authenticity boundary identified by dfbba165. Its factorial and per-family interaction requirements remain declarations. The gate validates presence/type/shape of summary fields and receipt digests, not that those digests commit to a case universe whose semantic_target x output_code factorial and treatment interaction can be independently reconstructed.
reentry_verdict.important_narrowing: This is not a claim that v5 is ineffective. It correctly fails closed on omission and adds several orthogonal confound controls. The remaining gap is specifically declaration-to-executed-evidence binding.

counterhypothesis.statement: The existing receipt digests may already point to trustworthy objects that contain the complete factorial and interaction evidence, making gate-side reconstruction unnecessary.
counterhypothesis.falsifier_for_this_research_finding: Demonstrate an exact-current producer/verifier chain in which v5 verifies the receipt contents or a typed upstream attestation that deterministically binds semantic target, output-code identity, case/control runtime receipts, and the interaction analysis to the exact candidate. A hash-shaped value alone does not establish this transitive binding.

strict_successor_requirement.name: CASE_BOUND_SEMANTIC_FACTORIAL_ATTESTATION/v1
must_recompute: semantic target counts in calibration and fresh holdout
declared split/family identities from exact case rows
six-control runtime receipt membership for every factorial cell
per-family treatment-by-semantic-target interaction from or against a digest-bound analysis object
must_bind: all required control runtime receipt sha256 values
anti_goodhart_regressions: A lying-summary candidate declares factorial=true but provides AFFIRMATIVE-only case rows; gate must fail.
A candidate provides all three semantic targets but omits one target x code cell; gate must fail.
A candidate provides a balanced table but interaction receipt binds a different case universe; gate must fail.
A valid 3x3 factorial candidate with exact row/control/analysis bindings may satisfy this evidence-authenticity layer, while remaining subject to all v4/v5 and later promotion gates.

coordination.reason: The current run records a successor evidence-contract requirement instead of creating a competing promotion authority while main is moving rapidly.

next_exact_action: Extend the retained v5 authority rather than fork it: add case-bound semantic-factorial/interaction evidence verification and the four fail-closed regressions above, then execute only deterministic exact-source tests on an admitted zero-cost surface before considering a new native intervention.
